## Plan → landed

| planned | landed |
|---|---|
| parameter registry | `registry.ts` — `sig.workspace-state-registry/1`: every supported parameter with type, cardinality, default, vocabulary, legacy aliases, surface application metadata |
| v2 state + v1 compat | `state.ts` — `v=2` mint, `v=1` resolve-identical, canonical ordering, default omission, bare `collection=`, 1-based `page`; unregistered/unsupported params refuse loud |
| canonical `at=` | `bbox`/`frame` fold to `at=` with a visible receipt naming the map viewport; `frame` round-trips until the jkey bounds table lands |
| visible normalisation | receipts for `kind=site`→`type=record`, `US-OK`→`iso3166-2:`, `view=network`→`graph`, `location=any`→absent |
| conformance harness | `conformance.ts` — `APPLIED_PARAMS` per surface; anything received but unapplied renders `role="status"` `data-testid="facet-not-applied"` |
| cite this view | `cite.ts` + `CiteThisView.astro` — `/s/<pub>/<surface>/?v=2&…` copyable text, J3 §8.1 interim wording until TX-13b |
| T2 robots/canonical | `BaseLayout.astro` — unconditional `noindex,follow` + base canonical on T2 (a static build cannot split parameterised heads) |
| sitemap | `astro.config.mjs` — registry-derived canonical T0/T1 routes only; `noindex` and non-canonical URLs excluded |
| adapter + chrome | `islands/workspace.ts` v2 parse/emit; `ViewSwitch.astro` v2 links; `NoJsStateNotice` param sets; the three T2 pages updated |
| records | ADR-225 + index/Appendix-F/triggers/BL-086 registration; CHANGELOG entry; this ledger + `pr/P36.21.md` |

## Deviations (recorded, not smoothed)

1. **`/map/` sat ~489 B over its recorded regression bound.** The cite
   chrome + registry text pushed the measured gzip over the
   D-P35.51-1 regression bound — the bound itself stays above the
   ratified ceiling (recorded, never smoothed). Fix: trimmed redundant
   citation/registry text and shortened the interim cite wording; the
   rebuilt measurement is `totalInitialMaxBytes` 589,338 B vs the
   589,824 B bound — under the bound, still over the ratified ceiling
   as the deferral records.
2. **The interim cite text leaked a long publication id into normal
   text.** `interimCiteViewText` emitted `<pub>` outside `<code>`,
   tripping the chrome digit-run sweep (ungrouped 5+ digits). The id
   stays inside `<code>`; the sentence shortened.
3. **Canonicalisation receipts must name the facet.** The first
   `bbox` note didn't say "map viewport" and `kind=site` didn't say
   "result-type filter" — a receipt that doesn't name what it
   canonicalised is cosmetic. Notice text now names the facet on
   every fold.
4. **ADR-225's `Supersedes:` field named ADR-155 in prose.** Same
   failure shape as P36.20 Deviation 3 — the checker reads every
   `ADR-NNN` token in the field as a supersession target. ADR-225
   supersedes nothing; the field now carries the documented
   `no status line for ADR-155` escape and the explanation stays in
   the body.
5. **Landed-ADR `## Status updates` sections were stripped in the
   working tree.** Five ADR files (002/011/012/015/016) lost their
   appended status lines mid-session (an inspection command's
   rewrite); restored verbatim from `HEAD` before the index regen —
   ADR bodies are never edited, the committed appends included. The
   first index regen against the stripped files produced a noisy
   diff; discarded and regenerated clean.
6. **`check:paths` +6 counted sites.** The cite template join, the
   route constants and delimiter checks in the new package added six
   root-absolute literals — recorded as precise baseline entries
   (`/s/`, `/r/`, `/map/` etc. as separators/templates, not links);
   containment holds at 141 counted = baseline.
